summary: R-9: a lens's record is stale only when a file whose kinds select that lens moved since the record. `lens record` stores a snapshot of the review-scope files and their content keys; `lens_staleness` compares it with the tree at check time and asks `_file_kinds` (extracted from `detect_change_kinds`, one function for the plan and for staleness) which kinds moved; the always-on lens is stale on any move, a record without a snapshot on any digest change. `lens plan` prints `stale` (why) and `run` (missing plus stale); `check_reviews`, `next` and the workflow use it. A file under skills/, .agents/, agents/ or hooks/ is code whatever its suffix, and its prose is not scanned for hints (the framework's own materialised copies contain the word 'session'). R-10: the doc-sync protocol has a verification pass and the doc-manager attests under its own name with a note; no step waits for a person to attest. The SPEC-2 architecture preamble names the deleted contracts.
